features: Up to 16 IP cameras with audio
Recording 480 (400) fps at 6 MP / 5 MP / 3 MP / Full HD / 720p, depending on camera model
Playback 30 (25) fps at 6 MP to 720p, 480 (400) fps at D1 / VGA, depending on camera model
Playback: 1, 4, 6, 7, 8 channels on HDMI monitor, paged 8+8 mode, up to 4 channels in web interface
Recording format: H.264 HP/MP/BP (video), G.711 a-law/u-law 8 kHz (audio)
Alarm: 4 inputs (NO or NC), 1 output (24 V, 1 A)
BEWARD BD-series cameras compatible (H.264 only); BEWARD B, N and third-party cameras via ONVIF 2.0 and above (H.264 only)
